summary: Banco Santander-Chile filed a Form 6-K furnishing Exhibit 99.1, its Management Commentary for the period ended September 30, 2026, approved by the Board on October 27, 2026, and signed by General Counsel Cristian Florence on October 30, 2026. The document is a routine quarterly IFRS Practice Statement 1 management commentary covering highlights, strategy, financial position and outlook under Chilean CMF bank accounting rules. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation on a deal, or structural mechanics are disclosed. Not a special situation; no risk-arb angle exists, and the only items to watch are ordinary operating results.
